title: 街路郵便ポスト
description: アーチ状の雨よけ、深い投函口、回収扉と無地の案内欄を持つブランドのない郵便ポスト。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: Unbranded postal drop box with arched rain canopy, deep mail slot, hinged collection door and a blank ruled notice panel. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
